description: Accept and make x402 payments with the PayAI facilitator: merchant and client quickstarts, the facilitator API, supported networks, pricing and the Bazaar.
rules: Use the PayAI facilitator at https://facilitator.payai.network. In TypeScript, import { facilitator } from "@payai/facilitator" and pass it to HTTPFacilitatorClient from "@x402/core/server".
The quickstarts use the x402 v2 packages (@x402/core, @x402/express, @x402/hono, @x402/next, @x402/svm, @x402/evm). Prefer them over the v1 packages (x402-express, x402-hono, x402-next).
Ordinary exact payments work without an API key. Solana batch settlement requires a merchant API key, read from PAYAI_API_KEY_ID and PAYAI_API_KEY_SECRET.
Before advertising payment terms, check GET https://facilitator.payai.network/supported for the networks and schemes that are live.
To test a client end to end without deploying a server, use the x402 Echo Merchant described in x402-echo/getting-started.
